pages.text: $(bold)Easy Magic$(): the table keeps items, and you re-roll the offers.$(br)$(bold)Easy Anvils$(): anvils keep their items and are easier to use.$(br)$(bold)Easy Disenchanting$(): pull enchantments off an item onto a book.$(br)$(bold)XP Tome$(): store your XP in a book.
The trick: bosses drop gear enchanted past the vanilla limit (Protection VII, Power VIII). Disenchant the pieces you do not want and put those books on the set you wear.
